## How you checked it

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] If this touches `functions/` or sign-in: `tests/security.ts` and `tests/ui.ts` against a preview
- [ ] If this touches the engine: `tests/golden.test.ts` still passes **without** re-recording it
- [ ] A test covers the fix or the new behaviour
- [ ] Docs updated if an endpoint, variable, limit or screen changed (the docs test will tell you)
